info.name: SSG Voting System API
info.description: Complete Laravel API collection for the College SSG Voting System. Run folders in order on a fresh development database. State-changing requests cast a vote, create records, close the seeded election, and exercise a second draft election. Reset with `php artisan migrate:fresh` followed by `php artisan db:seed --class=DevelopmentSeeder`.

request.description: Authenticates the seeded administrator and stores the Bearer token in admin_token. Expected: 200. Errors: 401 invalid credentials, 422 invalid input, 429 throttled.

item.name: Secondary Voter Login - For Role Tests

request.description: Creates a voter token used only for cross-role authorization tests. Expected: 200.

item.name: Admin Endpoint with Voter Token - Forbidden

request.description: Valid voter tokens must not access administrator endpoints. Expected: 403.

item.name: Voter Endpoint with Admin Token - Forbidden

request.description: Valid administrator tokens must not access voter endpoints. Expected: 403.
Protected voter endpoint without authentication. Expected: 401.
Unknown Student ID must be rejected. Expected: 401.
Correct Student ID with wrong full name must be rejected. Expected: 401.
Graduated students cannot vote. Expected: 403.
Stopped students cannot vote. Expected: 403.
Inactive students cannot vote. Expected: 403.
Withdrawn students cannot vote. Expected: 403.
Validates Student ID, normalized full name, enrollment, active election, and prior participation. Stores voter_token. Expected: 200.
Returns the active election, positions, and candidates. Expected: 200. Errors: 401 missing token, 403 wrong token type, 409 no active election.
Revokes the current voter token. Expected: 200.
Obtains a fresh voter token after the logout test. Expected: 200.
Creates participation, anonymous ballot, and candidate selections in one transaction. Revokes the token after success. Expected: 201.
Mandatory duplicate-vote test after successful submission. Expected: 409.

item.name: 02 - Admin Read APIs
item.description: Read-only administrator checks. The folder starts with its own login so it can be run independently.

request.description: Refreshes admin_token so this folder can run independently. Expected: 200.
Returns turnout, candidate counts, team totals, and results by position. Expected: 200.
Paginated student list with optional status and search filters. Expected: 200.
Lists all elections, newest first. Expected: 200.
Lists positions for one election in display order. Expected: 200.
Lists candidate profiles, teams, and positions for one election. Expected: 200.

item.name: 03 - Admin Student Management
item.description: Administrator student creation and update checks. The folder logs in and generates a fresh Student ID each time it runs.

request.description: Refreshes admin_token so this folder can run independently. Expected: 200.
Creates an enrolled student. Expected: 201 on a fresh database; 422 if rerun without resetting.
Updates a student's name and academic eligibility. Expected: 200. Errors: 404 unknown student, 422 invalid status.

item.name: 04 - Draft Election Workflow
item.description: State-changing admin workflow. It starts with its own admin login, so this folder can be run independently. Run it after the voter tests because it closes the seeded election, then activates and closes the new draft election.

request.description: Authenticates the seeded administrator and refreshes admin_token so this folder can run by itself. Expected: 200.
Creates a draft election and stores draft_election_id. Expected: 201.
Updates draft configuration. Expected: 200. Non-draft elections return 409.
Creates the primary position for the draft election and stores draft_position_id. Expected: 201.
Updates a position while its election is draft. Expected: 200.
Creates a disposable position used to test deletion and stores temporary_position_id. Expected: 201.
Deletes an unused position from a draft election. Expected: 200.
Creates or updates a candidate profile and candidacy without a photo. Expected: 201.

item.name: Upload Candidate Photo - Select File First

request.description: Before sending, select a JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP file no larger than 2 MB for profile_photo. Do not manually set Content-Type. Expected: 201.
Confirms the draft election candidate, team, position, motto, and optional photo URL. Expected: 200.
STATE CHANGE: closes the seeded active election so the draft workflow can test successful activation. Run only after voter tests. Expected: 200.
Activates a configured draft election after the seeded election is closed. Expected: 200.
Confirms configuration locking after activation. Expected: 409.
Closes the newly activated test election. Expected: 200.
Revokes the current administrator token. Expected: 200.
